important: These are field-buffer statistics, not necessarily cadastral field-boundary statistics.
Replace the circle with an actual field polygon for production use.
Coarse datasets retain their native resolution; GPM/ERA5 use a 6 km support radius and SMAP a 5 km support radius.
Missing raster reductions are exported as -9999 (missing_value_code); convert this sentinel to null before analysis.
SoilGrids values are raw stored values; consult official per-property scale factors before interpretation.
SMAP L4 V8 has a documented geolocation issue/reprocessing period from 2026-05-14 to 2026-07-28.
GAEZ v5, GRACE-FO and India market/economic resources are documented as separate steps.
